* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the errata card image (23 July 2024, 3 days after release)<ref name="ht-d6a6c83">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d6a6c8357ee1271111a23c1a199474dae7c25313/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/electrorangefinder.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/electrorangefinder.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d6a6c8357ee1271111a23c1a199474dae7c25313 d6a6c83] “PhysChokeV and ERFv fixes”, 23 July 2024, 3 days after release.</ref> prints: “Deploy on an AT-AT; may immediately search your Used Pile and take an AT-AT Cannon or [Hoth] Epic Event into hand; reshuffle. Adds 2 to each of this AT-AT’s weapon destiny draws (unless targeting a character).” '''What changed:''' The words are unchanged. The round icon at top left changed: the first image showed an explosion picture, the re-made image a picture of three hexagons. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.

* '''PC-E2''' ([[Electro-Rangefinder (V) (Errata 2)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 2 August 2024: “Deploy on an AT-AT; may immediately search your Used Pile and take an AT-AT Cannon or [Hoth] Epic Event into hand; reshuffle. Adds 2 to each of this AT-AT's weapon destiny draws (unless targeting a character).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Electro-Rangefinder (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “Electro-Rangefinder”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Electro-Rangefinder (V) (Errata)]] (published 24 July 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Electro-Rangefinder]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
